Account snapshot: Sable Concord is a mid-size defense analytics contractor focused on secure large-scale document search for multiple DoD programs. Primary ask: replace legacy TF-IDF search + slow Elastic rerank with a RAG pipeline using embeddings + learned reranker, deployed in an air-gapped on-prem enclave.

Recent timeline (high level):
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (AE/SE) — customer described 50M+ indexed artifacts (reports, comms, imagery metadata). Wants sub-200ms p99 for top-k search under normal load.
- 2026-02-28: Deep dive (SE Daniel Park) — Fireflies ff_20260228_1245. Went over index architecture, vector store options, quantization tradeoffs.

Use-case notes / technical constraints (shorthand):
- Scale: target index 40–75M documents; average doc length 1.2k tokens; expect heavy tail of long sequences.
- Embeddings: prefer 1024/1536 dims? customer currently evaluating 768 vs 1024. Wants recommendations tied to cost/latency.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline — ANN recall + transformer-based re-ranker for top-100 -> top-10. Need p50 < 50ms for ANN recall; p99 for full pipeline < 200ms for latency-sensitive workflows.
- Throughput: baseline 120 QPS steady, bursts to 400 QPS for surge events.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement target ~<$0.02 / query for steady-state queries; flexible for spikes.
- Data residency: all indexing + inference must remain on-prem; no telemetry leaving enclave without explicit signed artifact.

Security / procurement specifics:
- Must satisfy ITAR and customer-specific CLA.
- Looking for FedRAMP-equivalent controls in private deployment; currently evaluating Redwood Private with HSM/KMS integration and audit logging retention 7 years.
- Contracting wants a fixed-price 12-month reserved capacity option for predictable budgeting (Dedicated-like).
